title: Minimum Cost to Set Cooking Time
goal: Enter a microwave time with minimum finger movement and button cost.
strategy: The display accepts up to two minute digits and two second digits, including seconds above 59. Enumerate all minute/second representations of the duration, remove leading zeros, and price each button sequence.
